selection_protocol: maximize full-split validation MRR; test evaluated once after selection
prior_test_exposure_note: fusion_v1 vs fixed_hybrid test metrics were observed in the initial pipeline phase before this sprint. Round-1/2 selection used validation only.

target.note: Under validation-based selection the chosen model IS fixed_hybrid, so delta is 0 by definition.

bottleneck: Linear fusion of L/I/S is near a performance ceiling under silver docstring labels; query features (especially Qid) lack variance to justify large weight shifts; models trained to be query-aware collapse toward near-constant weights or slightly hurt VAL MRR.
